text: The proposed revision to the accessible parking space on the east side of Beresford Avenue and replace with the recommendations below.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item TE15.34, headed "Accessible Parking Spaces - July 2024 (Delegated)", from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services, for further consideration, pertaining only to the accessible parking space on the east side of Beresford Avenue. 2. Deleted the entry in Attachment 1, On-street Accessible Parking Spaces to be Installed/Removed, at the location identified in Table 2 to the report (June 21, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services, pertaining only to the accessible parking space on the east side of Beresford Avenue, and replace it with the following: On-street accessible parking spaces to be removed: Ward 4 Location Beresford Avenue, east side, between a point 152 metres north of Colbeck Street and a point 5.5 metres further north.
